title: skills(pm-dispatch): `pm:awaiting-maintainer` owes a `Maintainer-action:` entry line, read by H55; 具名不升级类 gains the four bookkeeping classes
body:
Fixes #17017

Maintainer, 2026-09-09, verbatim and untranslated — the two instructions that opened the card. The first is the authority for Half B, the second for Half A:

> 「5986 这种任务不影响我们的产品质量，不应该让人类决策，项目经理自己当场决定就可以，而且这个应该开技能卡纠正」

> 「这个不应该是决策卡吗？哪个流程出了问题？」

Governed surface (`.claude/**`) ⇒ draft, human merge; `skip-changeset` (nothing here publishes: `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` ship in no package `files[]`).

## Half A — `pm:awaiting-maintainer` gains a machine carrier

The state had a semantic contract (决定已做, one action a seat cannot perform) and no machine carrier: `pm:blocked` owes `Blocked-by:`, `pm:on-hold` owes `Restart-when:`, and this state owed nothing, so a card waiting for a JUDGEMENT was indistinguishable from one waiting for a HAND.

- **`references/state-machine.md` §`pm:awaiting-maintainer` 与 `pm:retriage`** now specifies the entry line (the two placeholders are spelled as words in this PR body because the platform mutates angle-bracket fragments; the file carries them literally, in the same shape as `Restart-when: closed OWNER/REPO#N`):
  - `awaiting 入态带 Maintainer-action: ACTION — done when EVIDENCE,双通道行锚定。` — ACTION = 席位做不了的动作, EVIDENCE = 可查证据; body OR comment; line-anchored and case-sensitive like the two sibling lines.
  - `写不出即决定待做;本态无机器出口:维护者完成后由总监席核验摘标 + 证据评论同笔。` — the classification test the card asked for (「裁完之后」 is the definition of `needs-user-decision`), folded onto the existing exit line.
- **`SKILL.md` 状态模型 row** (pointer form, table row extended in place, 234 B ≤ the 342 B table pin): `…;入态恒带行首 Maintainer-action: 行(细则见 references/state-machine.md),无行即半态`.
- **`references/core-rules.md`** twin (in place): `pm:awaiting-maintainer 只剩站外人工动作,恒带 Maintainer-action: 行;pm:blocking ⛔ 不手工挂。`
- **`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` — H55**, report-only, band `state`: an open card carrying the label whose body and thread carry no complete `Maintainer-action:` line. The line is read by the shared decorated-directive reader (`directiveValues`), so it is line-anchored, case-sensitive, decoration-tolerant, and a mid-sentence mention is prose. Both halves are required: a value without its `done when` half fires as "names an act but never its completion". The thread is bought only for a judged, body-clean card (`needsMaintainerActionComments`, H9's gate one field over) on the shared comment cache; three input states for the thread (unconsulted / unreadable / read), the unreadable one fires and says so. Remedy text: write the line if the act exists; **if the line cannot be written because the card is asking for a RULING, the state is `needs-user-decision` (决定待做)** and the entry was misfiled; the 台账 reader is the director seat's 职责三 (维护者动作台账). ⛔ **Not a machine exit** — the state still has none by construction; the row judges the ENTRY only.
  - **Reconciliations, pinned on the source** (H54's discipline): the H11 important-parked note now reads "has no machine exit BY CONSTRUCTION … the state now has an ENTRY predicate … and STILL no machine exit", and its awaiting remedy tells the re-ask to read the card's `Maintainer-action:` line first (still never prescribing a `Restart-when:` re-check — the existing pin at :19486 holds). H25's deferral note ("any requirement that the card NAME the awaited action … a protocol face the state-model row has not been written for yet") now says that face exists and H55 reads it; H25 stays the EXCLUSIVITY half, H55 is the ENTRY half, neither widened into the other.

### Population scoping (ruling 2) — the landing day must not be red on the healthy case

Entries are split at a pinned instant, `MAINTAINER_ACTION_LINE_SINCE = '2026-09-10T00:00:00Z'` (the UTC day after the rule was written, in the file's own pinned-date idiom): a card last touched BEFORE it is a legacy entry and renders as ONE summary census clause — `Awaiting-maintainer entries (H55): N open pm:awaiting-maintainer card(s) last touched before … — COUNTED here and filed as no row …, oldest #N (last touched YYYY-MM-DD); …` — never as rows; a card touched ON/AFTER it is judged and can be a row.

**The split reads `updated_at`, not the `labeled` event — the trade, stated.** The entry instant is in no payload the sweep already holds (assumption C, measured: the loop holds the label pages' issue payloads, and the only event reader, H35, consumes the repo-wide stream filtered to gate-semantic labels — `pm:awaiting-maintainer` is not one), and this file's standing design makes no per-card timeline fetch. `updated_at` is the cheapest honest proxy and its error runs one way: `updated_at` is never earlier than the labelling, so a card last touched before the pin certainly entered before it (the census can never hide a post-pin entry); a legacy entry TOUCHED after the pin lands among the judged and can render as a row — an over-read costing one cheap idempotent act (write the line, or reclassify) on a card someone is already handling. An unreadable `updated_at` is judged, never counted as legacy.

### Measurement — the live board at authoring (2026-09-09T17:4xZ; REST list endpoint + per-card `/events`; 0 MCP calls)

| repo | open `pm:awaiting-maintainer` | cards (entry = last `labeled` event → last touch) |
|---|--:|---|
| objectstack | 5 | #16737 (09-08T14:01 → 09-09T15:31, +25 h), #15233 (09-09T10:29 → same), #17129 (09-09T11:42 → same), #16804 (09-09T11:44 → 13:55, +2 h; also carries `needs-user-decision` — H25 already fires), #17151 (09-09T13:21 → same) |
| objectui | 2 | #5828 (08-29T06:45 → 08-29T06:46), #6596 (09-09T05:34 → same) |
| hotcrm | 0 | — |
| **total** | **7** | 5 of 7 have `updated_at` within 3 s of the `labeled` event; 2 were touched after entering |

**Premise shift, reported rather than pressed:** the card measured 55 (37 / 16 / 2) on 2026-09-09 and 55 → 55 across ~14 h. By dispatch the population was **7**: the repo-wide events stream (H35's channel, read 30 pages per repo back to 2026-09-09T03:38Z / 2026-09-08T17:07Z) shows a reclassification pass that morning — objectui 15 `unlabeled pm:awaiting-maintainer` at 02:56–03:04Z, objectstack's named specimens at 02:29–05:12Z (#13636, #16500, #12675, #12884, #15406 unlabeled and closed; #12034 back to `pm:queue`). The three defects the card names (no carrier, H8 blind to the chosen state, the sweep reading shape and time only) are unchanged by the count, so the design stands; what changes is the landing-day shape — with the pin above, all 7 render as the census clause on the first sweep, not as rows. The `search` endpoint answers 403 from this container, so the control reading is the events stream plus a list-endpoint control on a populous label (`pm:dispatched` = 26 open).

## Half B — the floor of what may reach the maintainer

具名不升级类 (SKILL.md 〈升级与决策〉) gains the four bookkeeping classes, each bounded by 「无产品可见行为变化」 so none reads as widening; the 人工地板 lines (SKILL.md :390–:392 after the shift; core-rules :95–:96) are byte-untouched and remain the exclusion set.

- SKILL.md, after `具名不升级类(立即行动):…`:
  - `- 四类记账事同属不升级类,恒以无产品可见行为变化为界:去重与卡片合并;台账与记账整理;` (120 B)
  - `- 纯文档措辞更正(无契约声明改动);门禁内部参数与扫描器盲区修复(加强,非削弱)。` (110 B)
- core-rules.md twin, after `具名不升级类:…`: `- 记账事不升级(无产品可见行为变化):去重并卡、台账整理、纯文档措辞、门禁盲区加强。` (119 B; the compressed spelling the 人读摘要 file uses for every twin).

Authority: the maintainer's first sentence above — cited here, ⛔ not inside the skill text (the skill states rules; `check:pm-skill-id-lint` keeps citations out).

## Mechanism assumptions (派发词 — tested before acting)

- **A (pinned lines).** `check-governed-prose` pins the SKILL.md region between `**ACCEPT 之后的路径分叉` and `本段只适用本循环派发的 dev PR`; `check-half-states` pins `RELEASE_RULE_LINE` (SKILL.md's 释放是显式动作 line) and the retriage answer line; `check-skill-frame-sync` pins the four-axis frame; `check-clause2-carriers` / `check-widening-tells` pin `references/contract-review.md` and the claim spelling. None of the deleted or edited lines is in any pinned set — all six gates are green below. Held.
- **B (director.md).** :52 「`pm:awaiting-maintainer` 跨仓标签是待人工动作的唯一机器载体」 was read as the label being the unique carrier of the STATE (against seat-post prose, :55 「标签即状态」), while the new line is the label's machine half specified in `state-machine.md`, which :56 already points at (「出口条款见 ../state-machine.md」); :54 「台账与出口归本席」 is what the H55 remedy names. No sentence contradicts the line ⇒ left untouched, per the ruling. Noted in Acceptance notes as the one reading a reviewer may want to overturn.
- **C (entry date from what the sweep holds).** Falsified — measured above; ruling 2's stated fallback (`updated_at`) taken, trade stated in the header, the row text and the summary clause.
- **D (line numbers).** The card's `SKILL.md:110/:126` are :111/:127 on `a9550bf8`; `check-half-states.mjs:2298` is :2302 (the note) / :2307 (the remedy); 具名不升级类 :714 and 人工地板 :391–:393 as cited. Worked from the tree.

## Reverse verification (one-time ablation, committed state, restore proven by bytes)

Committed first (`af85c612`), then mutated under a `trap restore EXIT INT TERM` with absolute paths: the first statement of `h55AwaitingWithoutMaintainerAction` was made `return null` (marker `ABLATION-17017-MARKER`). Landing proven on disk before reading any result: marker count 0 → 1 on the anchor line, blob `f015273c…` ≠ HEAD blob `0ec90893…`. Expected direction: RED (the positive control and every row-text case), the census/registry/summary cases unaffected — observed exactly that: `✗ check-half-states self-test: 20 of 3103 case(s) failed.`, the 20 being the six `H55 fires:` cases, the three thread-state cases, the undated case and the ten `H55 row:` sentence cases; every neighbour (H9, H11, H25, H54, summary clauses, band registry) stayed green. Restore leg: `git checkout HEAD -- ABSOLUTE_PATH` (never a bare checkout — the index is the mutation), proven by `git diff HEAD --stat` empty, `git status --porcelain` empty, `git hash-object` = `0ec90893d36c84e19c8721b755252781b8b8b805` = `git rev-parse HEAD:scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`, marker count back to 0; the restored run reads `✓ check-half-states self-test: 3103 cases pass.` again. No `dist/` is involved (the sweep runs from source), so no dist preflight applies; no permanent test file was left behind.

## Acceptance notes

- **The bounded reclassification worklist is a LATER, separate act — named here, ⛔ not filed** (ruling 2): the 7 live carriers above, each read per-thread and either given its `Maintainer-action:` line or moved to `needs-user-decision` (决定待做) / closed. #16804 already carries both `needs-user-decision` and `pm:awaiting-maintainer` (H25 fires on it today) — first in that worklist. No live card was touched by this PR.
- **director.md :52 reading** (assumption B): left untouched on the reading above. If the reviewer reads 「唯一机器载体」 as contradicted by a second machine-read carrier, the in-place edit is `…唯一机器载体,其 Maintainer-action: 行即台账行。` — it measures 122 B, 2 over the cap, so it would cost a fold elsewhere in the 72/72 file; not done here.
- **`done when` required** — H55 reads "both parts" literally: a `Maintainer-action:` value without a `done when` half fires as half a line (its own sentence). The dash spelling is not the contract (`—`, `-`, `--` all carry it); the KEY is byte-exact.
- **The EVIDENCE placeholder reads 可查证据, not 机器可查证据**, in the state-machine line: 6 bytes were needed to fit the 120-byte cap; "evidence a reader can check" is stated in the H55 row text.
- noted, not filed — 承接者:无: `check-half-states.mjs`'s `directiveValues` JSDoc named only two keys; widened to three (comment only). noted, not filed — 承接者: the reclassification worklist above: the awaiting label's `ensure-pm-labels.sh` description (:212) still says "no machine exit" — true, and now incomplete (no mention of the entry line); a description string, no reader.
- `GET /search/issues` answers 403 from this container (so did MCP-free dedup rely on the events stream + list endpoint); `Maintainer-action` had 0 hits on `origin/main` at dispatch and this PR is its first spelling.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

### 改了什么
给 `pm:awaiting-maintainer`(等您亲手做一件事的状态)加了一条必填的机器可读行:`Maintainer-action: 要做的那件事 — done when 怎么验证做完了`。写不出这一行的卡,说明它等的不是您的手而是您的裁决,应当放进决策箱(`needs-user-decision`)。巡查脚本新增 H55 报"进了这个状态却没写这行"的卡(只报告不改标签);今天之前已在状态里的卡只汇总成一行计数,不逐张报红。另外,四类纯记账事(去重合卡、台账整理、纯文档措辞更正、门禁内部参数与盲区加强)明确列为 PM 当场自决、不上报您。

### 为什么改
您 09-09 的两句话:5986 那种任务不该让人决策、该开技能卡纠正;以及"这不应该是决策卡吗?哪个流程出了问题?"。溯源结果是:这个状态只有定义没有载体,谁都能挂、没人能证伪,H8 只查有没有转状态、不查转对没有,巡查只看形状和时间不看含义。卡上当天量到 55 张里约 49 张挂错;派发时板上已剩 7 张(上午有一轮改判),缺陷本身没变。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)
三个技能文件都在行数上限,每加一行删一行(删的都是别处已有的重复表述,PR 正文逐行列出)。H55 判"新旧"用的是卡片 `updated_at` 而不是打标签时刻(不做逐卡 timeline 请求),代价是:老卡在 09-10 之后被碰过就会被当新卡报一次,补一行即消;绝不会漏报新卡。回滚 = revert 本 PR,无数据、无标签、无 workflow 变化。
